inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL maintenance load inserts rows from a SELECT and uses ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE with LEAST and GREATEST to merge lower and upper observations into an existing summary.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored quota-window merge. LOW_PRIORITY and IGNORE are combined with an INSERT SELECT upsert; an existing window keeps the lower minimum and higher maximum while a new window is inserted. The source schema, identifiers, values, and performance-history purpose are not copied.

fixture_notes: The north quota window already stores minimum 10 and maximum 20; incoming observations 7 and 26 must widen it to 7 and 26. The south window is new and must be inserted unchanged.
determinism_notes: Window keys, bounds, and source ordering are fixed; the final read is ordered by the unique window key. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE quota_windows (window_key VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, minimum_value INT NOT NULL, maximum_value INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE quota_window_batch (window_key VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, observed_minimum INT NOT NULL, observed_maximum INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT LOW_PRIORITY IGNORE INTO quota_windows (window_key, minimum_value, maximum_value) SELECT window_key, observed_minimum, observed_maximum FROM quota_window_batch ORDER BY window_key ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE minimum_value = LEAST(quota_windows.minimum_value, VALUES(minimum_value)), maximum_value = GREATEST(quota_windows.maximum_value, VALUES(maximum_value))

checks.sql: SELECT window_key, minimum_value, maximum_value FROM quota_windows ORDER BY window_key
